Black Friday / Cyber Monday 2026 · checked 2026-10-31

The Black Friday VPS price isn’t what you pay at renewal.

Answer: The Black Friday price is not what you pay at renewal. As of 2026-10-31, Hostinger's VPS sale lists KVM 2 (2 vCPU / 8 GB) at $8.79/mo, but only on a 24-month prepay ($210.96 today), and it renews at $14.99/mo (+71%). Its 3-year cost is $390.84 ($10.86/mo averaged). The biggest renewal jump is KVM 4: $12.99 → $28.99 (+123%). Even at renewal, these plans stay below Vultr and DigitalOcean list prices for the same RAM; the catch is the up-front prepay and the lock-in.

Key stats
  • Deals verified on vendor pages: 4 (Hostinger KVM 1, 2, 4, 8)
  • Prepay required: 24 months, paid up front ($155.76–$623.76)
  • Renewal jump: +71% to +123%
  • Checked with no Black Friday VPS price shown: 7 providers
  • Last verified: 2026-10-31

Deal price vs what you actually pay

USD, list prices before tax. “1 year” is cash out of pocket: the deal requires a 24-month prepay, so leaving after 12 months still costs the full prepay (after the 30-day money-back window). “3 years” = the prepay + 12 months at the renewal rate.

Hostinger shows crossed-out prices (KVM 1 $19.49, KVM 2 $24.49, KVM 4 $42.99, KVM 8 $73.99); we don’t use them as a baseline.

How to judge any Black Friday VPS deal

  • Find the renewal price and the term it renews for. Multiply it out; that is your real price from month 25.
  • Find the prepay. “$8.79/mo” billed as $210.96 today is a 24-month commitment.
  • Compare 3-year cost, not the headline monthly rate, against a monthly-billed plan you could leave any time.
  • Count the extras: backups (included at Hostinger, +20% at Vultr), IPv4, bandwidth overage.

Questions

What is the best Black Friday VPS deal in 2026?

We only list deals we read on the vendor's own page. As of 2026-10-31 that is Hostinger's VPS sale: KVM 1 $6.49/mo (renews $11.99), KVM 2 $8.79/mo (renews $14.99), KVM 4 $12.99/mo (renews $28.99), KVM 8 $25.99/mo (renews $49.99), each on a 24-month prepay. DigitalOcean, Vultr, Hetzner, OVHcloud, DreamHost, IONOS, Contabo showed no Black Friday VPS price on the pages we read that day.

How much does a Hostinger Black Friday VPS cost after renewal?

KVM 1: $6.49/mo now, renews at $11.99/mo (+85%); KVM 2: $8.79/mo now, renews at $14.99/mo (+71%); KVM 4: $12.99/mo now, renews at $28.99/mo (+123%); KVM 8: $25.99/mo now, renews at $49.99/mo (+92%). Hostinger's page says the renewal is "for the same term", so renewing a 24-month plan is billed up front again (KVM 2: $359.76).

Do I have to prepay to get the Black Friday VPS price?

Yes for Hostinger: the page says "All plans are paid upfront" and each deal shows the 24-month total (KVM 1 $155.76). Hostinger offers a 30-day money-back guarantee. Vultr and DigitalOcean bill monthly/hourly with no prepay.

Is a Black Friday VPS cheaper than DigitalOcean or Vultr over 3 years?

KVM 1 (4 GB): $299.64 over 3 years vs Vultr $720.00, DigitalOcean $864.00; KVM 2 (8 GB): $390.84 over 3 years vs Vultr $1,440.00, DigitalOcean $1,728.00; KVM 4 (16 GB): $659.64 over 3 years vs Vultr $2,880.00, DigitalOcean $3,456.00; KVM 8 (32 GB): $1,223.64 over 3 years vs Vultr $5,760.00. List prices only; Vultr automatic backups add 20%, Hostinger includes weekly backups.
